title: Parametric involute gear wheel (Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine))
seed: Build a script from scratch in Babylon.js (Node.js, headless NullEngine) that procedurally generates: Generate a gear wheel: a cylindrical disc with N teeth extruded around its rim (trapezoidal or involute-style tooth profile), plus a central bore hole. Number of teeth, module (tooth size), disc thickness, and bore radius must be CLI-configurable. Save to glb with deterministic seeding, CLI parameterization, and an independent post-save validation step.
